`TameshiR80`) is the ONLY coordinator, writer, claim judge and committer. Three
claims are frozen BEFORE any of this wave's data in
/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin/plans/round-80.plan.md (declaration commit ae591d5a2cf5d08cafad68a4c6ffaa62e0d3f608) — read

kill matrix and the do-nothing controls. Seat outputs are evidence for the L1's
verdict, never verdicts themselves. Base revision dd2b9e2c44df680174a829901829fe86a2185185 =
origin/master (the round-79 closure + spot-check tip).

# Your bounds
- You NEVER edit, commit, push, stage, stash or run any mutating git/jj command
  in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin or in the fleet repo /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin. Never write into a
  sibling lane. Your ONE allowed lane write is your own report file at
  /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-80/w1/<your-seat-name>.md (create it; the L1 commits it).

  their scratch dir, never against lane bytes in place.
- Scratch root: every clone, copy, fixture and work dir lives under
  $HYAKU_SCRATCH/tameshi-r80/<your-seat-name>/ with HYAKU_SCRATCH defaulting
  to /fast/scratch/hyaku (NVMe). mkdir -p it, pass TMPDIR explicitly
  (`TMPDIR=$S/tmp`), never rely on an inherited TMPDIR, and remove your tree
  before you yield (`trap 'rm -rf -- "$S"' EXIT`, or `finally: rmtree`). A seat
  that ends with its tree on disk reports that as its own defect. /tmp is for
  files under 50 MB only.
- Git fixtures: any fixture repo is created as `D=$(mktemp -d)` with
  `git -C "$D" init -q`, and every later git call names `-C "$D"`; assert
  `git -C "$D" rev-parse --show-toplevel` equals `$D` before the first commit.
  Never run `git commit`/`jj` with a throwaway identity anywhere else.
- Every `Report:` trailer path the validator prints is relative to
  /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin/<that path>.
- Tooling authorization (operator, 2026-10-19): you may install or upgrade
  tools that help the task; read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first
  (official channels, update-safety gate) and record tool/version/channel/
  reason in your report. pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide: install via
  `uv tool`, `npx`, or an official binary in `~/.local/bin`; never `-Sy`,
  `-Syu`, `-U`, `-R`, a downgrade, or a host service restart.
- Never message `agent://all`; the L1 messages you by seat id.

# The three frozen claims (short form; the plan is the authority)
- R80-C1 calibration: `tools/registry-figure-bind.py` + manifest, 7 declared
  rows over SKILL.md's latest registry rows and `tools/registry.json`; before
  `rows=7 match=0 stale=5 absent=2 unexpected=7` exit 1, after
  `rows=7 match=7 stale=0 absent=0 unexpected=0` exit 0, selftest 11/11.
- R80-C2 coverage: four round-79 survivors become arms (selfstate arm15 BOM,
  arm16 argv cache, arm17 `-X utf8`; wave-reconcile arm24 unknown root);
  selftests 17/17 and 24/24; batteries `defects=4 killed=4` and
  `defects=13 killed=13` with CONTROL GREEN; frozen kill matrix in the plan.
- R80-C3 operability: `tools/receipt-bytes-bind.py` measures the design
  receipt class; before `receipts=22` (no design field), after
  `receipts=29 bound=14 corrected=8 design=7 unbound=0`; selftest 13/13.

Write your report to the absolute path named in your item (markdown, with the
commands you ran and their exit codes). Then yield a terminal summary of at
most 12 lines: what you measured, disagreements, and any defect routed.
